span02.label: Span-02

classify1.label: Classify-1
classify1.note: Only accepts a state that is a string or an object with text or document fields, so it rejected every case except the 200 DAIR Emotion cases, whose state is {"text": ...}. The 3,050 rejected cases count as wrong. It also rejects image_url parts, so it has no vision score. Its latency and cost come from the 200 calls it answered.

d1_1.note: The successor to d1, served as liquid/d1.1-20261027. 64K context. Doesn't answer Box questions.

mammoth1.note: 27B, built on Qwen3.5-27B by Base Labs, Baseten's research team. MIT weights (baselabs/mammoth-1). Text only.

elephant1.label: Elephant 1

elephant1.note: 9B, built on Qwen3.5-9B by Base Labs, Baseten's research team. MIT weights (baselabs/elephant-1). Text only.

joey1.label: Joey 1
joey1.latency: API; not timed (round 9 ran from a machine whose round trips don't compare with the board's)
joey1.note: Built on Qwen3.5-2B by Base Labs, Baseten's research team. MIT weights (baselabs/joey-1). Text only.

glide.label: GLiDE
glide.latency: API; not timed (round 10 ran on Fastino's own API from a machine whose round trips don't compare with the board's)
glide.note: Ran on Fastino's own API, which reports the model as glide_v2. The open weights are V1.2 (fastino/GLiDE, 26B, Fastino's community licence). Cost is input tokens at the $0.04 per 1M list price, since the API reports no cost. Doesn't answer Box questions.

celeris1.label: Celeris-1 Decision
celeris1.latency: API; not timed (round 11 ran on Celeris's own API from a machine whose round trips don't compare with the board's)
celeris1.note: Closed weights, on Celeris's own System One endpoint. Cost is input tokens at the $0.04 per 1M list price, since the API reports no cost. It accepts images but scored at chance on every image dataset (50.0% on SST-2 from an image, against 95.5% on the same reviews as text), so it has no vision score. Doesn't answer Box questions.

meragpt_decider1.label: Decider 1
meragpt_decider1.latency: API; not timed (round 11 ran on meraGPT's own API from a machine whose round trips don't compare with the board's)
meragpt_decider1.note: Rejects any question with more than 10 options, so all 200 cases each of Banking77 (77 options), Arabic MASSIVE scenario (18) and Arabic MASSIVE intent (20) count as wrong; on the other 13 datasets it averages 75.5. Its 4,096-token cap rejects every image, so it has no vision score. The API takes state-decider-1 or decider-1 and reports decider-1. Cost is as billed, rounded to the millionth of a dollar per call. Its latency, not timed for the board, was about 10 seconds a call.

roadmap.title: Next: own API, same request shape

items.name: Hanzo Kai 1
items.note: Uses the same request shape as OpenRouter's Decisions API, on Hanzo's own endpoint. Closed weights; $0.021 per 1M input tokens. Started in round 11, but our key allows 60,000 tokens per 8 hours and a full run needs about 765,000, so it waits for a higher quota. It doesn't read images.

items.name: Kev size sweep
items.note: Apache 2.0. Kev 0.8B and 4B are on the board; five more sizes from 0.5B to 27B show how one recipe scales. 0.5B, 0.6B and 8B ship as LoRA adapters for kev.serve.

items.name: Leading community open models
items.note: The top open models on the S1MB leaderboard (30 September 2026). bekko is 400M parameters; its training data overlaps the S1MB domains, so an independent test matters.

items.name: Fastino GLiNER2.5-Decide and multi-Decide
items.note: Open weights on Hugging Face. 340M open-weight models; the multi version is multilingual.

items.name: vLLM Semantic Router d3, larger sizes
items.note: d3 edge, lite and nano are on the board. Mini (5.2 GB) and flash (9.5 GB) at Q8_0 fit a 24 GB Mac but are too slow for the 4-vCPU CPU the small sizes ran on; the 27B needs a bigger machine.

items.name: GLiClass Multilang
items.note: Open weights on Hugging Face. Small zero-shot classifier trained on 20 languages including Arabic: a cheap multilingual floor.

items.name: THX-01
items.note: 322M, Apache 2.0. Runs with thx01.load("doofz/THX-01").decide(state, questions), the same state and questions. For the next CPU round.

items.name: vLLM Semantic Router Decision-1.0 Eos 0.8B
items.note: Apache 2.0, built on Qwen3.5-0.8B. Serves /v1/systemone, so run_decisions.py --url runs it unchanged. For the next CPU round.

roadmap.title: Needs a track of its own

items.name: Respan Span-01 and Span-01 Lite
items.note: Only accepts a conversation (a list of chat messages) as the state and answers yes/no questions, so it needs a conversation track of its own. Span-02 takes a normal state and is on the board.

items.name: Cloudflare Clairic
items.note: Released 19 October 2026. Extracts typed values such as numbers and dates instead of making decisions, so it needs an extraction track.

items.name: Plain chat-model baselines
items.note: The same base models as Luna Decisions and Clef Flash, prompted for JSON. Shows what decision training adds.

items.name: Community distills
items.note: Unofficial open models trained to imitate decision models: JEV-9B, GEV-26B-Decide, the Mapika decider family and wfzyx/von. Worth a run once they have model cards and licences.

items.name: Gated, non-commercial or out-of-scope models
items.note: Surogate Rune 26B-A4B (gated weights), Torchcast Decision 27B (CC BY-NC 4.0), the fully open s1 on Gemma 4, and OpenThai-SystemOne (Thai, a language we don't test yet).

items.name: Other leaderboards
items.note: S1MB, JevBench, Decision Index and BenchLM publish decision-model results to cross-check ours against.

items.name: Clinical System One (CS1)
items.note: Research only: a paper, with no model to call or download yet.
